readme: The family DNS services SiteBlock can use for its adult content filter, and the one it uses. To switch, set 'active' to another provider's id (or add a provider with two IPv4 and two IPv6 addresses, each written in its standard short form) and release an update; the Mac and Windows builds both read this file, and their tests check it. Only family filters (services that refuse to look up adult sites) belong here, because SiteBlock promises that no setting turns the adult filter off.
